translations: His slaves and restricts for him
puzzle.hint: A comforting reminder that Allah never burdens a soul beyond what it can bear — each person is accountable for their own deeds.
puzzle.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
puzzle.verseEn: Allāh extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allāh is, of all things, Knowing.
